exposure.reason: Prior work exposed Context Plane and metadata delivery broadly; this exact tombstone/migration facet and source snapshot were not found in the bounded run audit. Do not count as holdout.

methodology.search: Deterministic source-local lexical search, two independent queries, maxResults=20, maxSnippetChars=240.
methodology.selection: Live Jev Choice on the union of top-20 exact search handles; exact-content duplicate ranges removed by fingerprint.
methodology.fetch: Re-read same snapshot and validate selected handles.
methodology.composition: Host assembles source-exact fetched text into a cited paragraph. Jev selects; Jev does not generate prose.
methodology.scores: Descriptive, uncalibrated. No threshold or production inference.
